features.subtitle: Our platform combines institutional-grade financial tools with real-time supply chain visibility.
features.feature1_desc: Precision monitoring of your cargo via satellite and IoT sensors across air, sea, and land routes.
features.feature2_desc: Smart contracts hold funds securely until delivery conditions are met and verified by digital BOLs.
features.feature3_desc: Automated customs documentation and regulatory checks for over 190 jurisdictions.

cta.title: CAN'T FIND YOUR PRODUCT?
cta.subtitle_1: WE MAY BE ABLE TO SOURCE IT FROM INDIA.
cta.subtitle_2: Share your product name, specifications and required quantity. Whether you are looking for a specific product, a new supplier, bulk quantities or an export-ready Indian sourcing option, our team will explore suitable options.

footer.description: Reimagining global trade infrastructure for the digital age. Secure, fast, and transparent.

compliance.subtitle: International trade requires accurate documentation and attention to product, destination, and regulatory requirements. RANOTE EXIM coordinates export documentation and works with relevant professionals and service partners where required to support compliant trade execution.
compliance.card1_desc: Preparation and coordination of commercial invoices, proforma invoices, and purchase orders aligned with buyer and destination country requirements.
compliance.card2_desc: Packing lists, shipping bills, bills of lading, and airway bills — coordinated with freight partners and customs house agents.
compliance.card3_desc: Assistance with certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates, test reports, and other product- or destination-specific documentation as applicable.
compliance.card4_desc: Working with trusted freight forwarders, customs brokers, and logistics partners to coordinate shipment from origin to destination.

connectivity.subtitle: Track your supply chain down to the individual vessel. Our satellite network provides 24/7 visibility on all active shipments.

hubs.title: Strategic Global Hubs
hubs.description: Our network of strategically located port facilities ensures your cargo never stops moving. From Shanghai to Rotterdam, we maintain priority access and dedicated customs channels.
hubs.main_subtitle: Our physical presence in 40+ major logistical hubs ensures your goods are handled with priority. From Singapore to Rotterdam, we provide on-ground support.

bulk.card_desc: We work with suitable Indian manufacturers and suppliers based on product requirements, specifications, quantity, quality expectations and export feasibility.

bulk.list_item2_desc: Coordinate product specifications and quality requirements.
bulk.list_item3_desc: Support documentation and shipment coordination for export orders.
